description: Canonical PresenceBeacon(21) + PresenceQuery(22) wire vectors. Beacon payload = {erid, geohash, capabilities, status, sent_at_ms}; query payload = {query_id, geohash}. UTF-8 JSON, declared field order, no whitespace, lowercase-dashed UUID for query_id, capabilities/status/sent_at_ms as bare integers (capabilities = NodeCapabilities bitmask, status = PresenceStatus value). The beacon carries the ROTATING erid (never the stable UHID) and a COARSE geohash (empty = hidden). Every language SDK MUST serialize to exactly these bytes.
